product.title: 독특 수제간식 강아지 치킨(3P 총중량120g) 멍치킨, 1개

meme.title: 통닭 털어 놓고 친구를 고발함
meme.scene: ONE LOCKED-OFF CAMERA for panels 1-5: static camera on the floor at dog eye level, vertical 9:16, exactly the same framing, position, lens and lighting in panels 1-5 (only the characters' poses change, like frames of one uncut 10-second shot). Bright modern home kitchen, white cabinets, light wood floor, cool daylight from a window. Foreground center on the floor: a torn-apart greasy human roast chicken carcass (glistening skin, shredded meat, bones, grease smears). Middle background, standing between the two dogs behind the mess: the owner, an ordinary man in a grey sweatshirt and dark joggers, bent forward at the waist with hands near his knees, angrily scolding down at the dogs. Shiba A on the LEFT: red-orange coat, cream chest, adult. Shiba B on the RIGHT: pale cream-sesame coat, slightly smaller. Both realistic, no clothes, no collars, no text, no watermark.
panels: 0s: owner bent over, mouth open mid-yell, one hand gesturing at the chicken mess; Shiba A sits upright with a shameless chin-up face; Shiba B sits with head lowered, ears flattened, guilty eyes looking up.
2s: same framing. Shiba A has its right front paw stretched out sideways, the tip pointing precisely at Shiba B, mouth slightly open; owner still bent over scolding; Shiba B head down, ears flat.

4s: same framing. Shiba A barks loudly up at the owner, mouth wide open showing teeth, ears forward, paw still pointing at Shiba B; owner leans back in surprise, eyebrows up; Shiba B eyes rolled toward Shiba A.

7s: same framing. Owner bends lower and points his index finger at Shiba A's raised right front paw, which clearly has glossy chicken grease and a shred of roast chicken meat stuck in the fur; Shiba A freezes mid-bark with wide eyes.

9s: same framing. Shiba A slowly lowers the paw and tucks it behind its body, looking away to the side with an awkward guilty face; Shiba B lifts its head and stares flatly at Shiba A; owner stands up with hands on hips.

12s (separate ad shot, chicken mess cleaned away, warmer light, owner out of frame): Shiba A sits front and center facing the camera with a smug confident face; in front of it a woven rattan basket full of golden-brown crumb-coated chicken-drumstick shaped dog treats exactly like the real product image (same golden-brown colour, not bright yellow); Shiba B with the SAME pale cream-sesame coat sits behind on the right, drooling at the basket.
meme.vo: 강아지가 먹는 치킨은 따로 있다. 구매는 프로필 링크에서.
meme.line_a: 사실 우리가 원한 건 뻑뻑한 통닭이 아니야!
